name: textarea
purpose: Multi-line text entry built on a native <textarea>, with label, required indicator, help text, localized constraint validation, optional character counter, and optional auto-grow sizing.
whenToUse: Free text that may span several lines: comments, descriptions, messages, addresses.
Long-form values with a length limit that users should see while typing.
Fields that need consistent, localized validation messages across browsers.
whenNotToUse: Single-line values such as names or email addresses: use Text Input.
Formatted rich text: use Rich Text Editor.
responsive: Full width of its container. Height follows `rows`; with resize 'auto' it grows with content between `rows` and `maxRows`, then scrolls. Density tokens adjust font size and padding.
rtl: Logical properties throughout; the native resize handle follows the writing direction.
theme: Control surface, border, focus, error, disabled, and sunken-surface role tokens. Focus shows a ring plus border color. Forced-colors mode draws a Highlight outline on focus.
security: Label, help text, and messages are rendered with textContent. Validation messages never include the entered value. Auto-grow writes block-size through the CSSOM (style.setProperty), never a style attribute. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. The native textarea carries the value for form submission when `name` is set.

performance.testedScale: Target: 1,000 textareas on one page (performance test pending the e2e harness entry).

limitations: `maxLength` is validated, not enforced by truncation: users can paste long text and correct it.
Lengths are counted in Unicode code points; grapheme clusters such as flag emoji count as more than one. Line breaks count as one character.
Without native `field-sizing` support, auto-grow measures on input and on render only; a container resize that rewraps text is applied on the next edit.
Only vertical resizing is offered; horizontal resizing breaks layouts.
unsupported: Rendering HTML in the label, help text, or messages.
Rich text, mentions, or syntax highlighting.
antiPatterns: Using the placeholder as the only label.
Using a single-row textarea for single-line values (use Text Input; Enter inserts a newline here).
Auto-grow without maxRows inside fixed-height layouts.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/textarea: AuiTextarea directive ([auiTextarea]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/textarea: AuiTextarea component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
